discoveries: DISCOVERY: the angle of every bright pair depends only on (P, Z) with P = [r_t = 0 and r_r = r_l] = [r in {000, 101}] (r = 101 is the kappa = 1 class, r = 000 the closed pair, all other classes kappa = 2 with one common coupling sign); on the occurring patterns (Z = 1 implies P = 1) psi = (4 sqrt2 - 2)/2 - 1/2 X_P - (1 + 4 sqrt2)/2 X_Z, so the X-controlled rotation needs 6 Walsh terms, and P costs nothing extra because it replaces the intermediate !d1 & !d2 of the Z chain (Z = P & !r_l).

DISCOVERY: rccx-based Toffoli toggles rccx(N1, N2 -> F) in the Gray path (instead of computing XF) leave the phase (-1)^(N1 p), p the parity of the controls toggled between the two X toggles; in a 2-register (P, Z) cube the X block's endpoints always differ in both registers, so the fix needs 2 CZ and the trick nets 0 CX.
best_full.summary: F1 round 4 on the F3 controlled-partner frame (parent r03-F3-002) with the class selector of the F1 line: frame, CH partner W Z_E W, single dark-label fold onto F, Margolus+CZ h_b Toffoli, 4 relative-phase C2H, closed gadget and the AND of 4 in-place corner tests as in the parent, but the closed-sector flag is built as Z = P & !r_l from the selector P = [r_t = 0 and r_r = r_l] = rccx(!r_t, !(r_r ^ r_l)) (same 6 CX as the delta chain it replaces), so the class-signed angle psi(P, Z) = -2, -1, 4 sqrt2 needs 3 Walsh terms instead of 5: the rotation on F is 6 Gray-cycle terms over (X, P, Z) instead of 10 (-4 CX, -4 rotations); all angles linear in alpha, beta, sqrt2 beta.
